frozen_protocol.block_plan: Synchronized moving-block resampling of UTC days in contiguous 5-day blocks, with the same sampled day indices shared across all 12 symbols, arms, sides, groups, timeframes, and outcomes. Resample non-wrapping 5-day blocks with replacement to the original fold's day count; retain all empty days. Report the 1-day synchronized block analysis only as a sensitivity.
frozen_protocol.null: Per-cell hypothesized net event mean = 0; center each cell's daily event sums by its observed event-weighted mean times that day's event count.
frozen_protocol.statistic: Event-weighted mean net return; empty UTC dates are retained in the 28-day calendar panel.

gate_decision_reason: At least one scenario's median marginal type-I point estimate exceeded the predeclared upper tolerance of 0.075.
interpretation: These are synthetic null experiments under specified illustrative dependence scenarios, not observed market data.
The 28-day fold, non-wrapping 5-day blocks, shared sampled date indices, and empty calendar dates follow the frozen protocol.
Finite p-values use (1 + exceedances) / (B + 1); a zero-event resample is retained and assigned null statistic 0, not omitted.
The run is deliberately modest; its binomial intervals are Monte Carlo uncertainty, not market uncertainty.
A PASS would not validate real-market assumptions, establish independent replications, or authorize claims on reserved folds.
limitations: Only 28 synthetic dates are available per simulated fold; moving blocks cannot characterize structural breaks or dependence longer than the block.
Synthetic factor structures and sparse activity are illustrative and cannot span all plausible event-generating processes.
Only empirical type-I rates are examined here; this is not a full power or confidence-interval coverage study.
The finite bootstrap p-value grid may be too coarse for 132-test Holm significance thresholds.

predeclared_gate.family_calibration: PASS only if all scenario Holm familywise 95% Wilson upper bounds are <=0.075 and raw p-value resolution reaches the first Holm threshold; FAIL on observed marginal point-rate breach; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
predeclared_gate.individual_calibration: FAIL if any scenario's median cell type-I point estimate falls outside the predeclared 0.025-0.075 tolerance; otherwise individual results remain diagnostic.
predeclared_gate.scope_guard: No raw iid event p-values, no reserved-data claims, and no implication of profitability or validation readiness.

predeclared_scenarios.ar1_day_null: Zero-mean AR(1) shared daily factor (rho=0.65) and arm factors (rho=0.45).
predeclared_scenarios.iid_day_null: Independent daily global/arm factors and event noise; zero-mean event returns.
predeclared_scenarios.shared_crossarm_factor: Strong shared daily factor across all 132 hypotheses plus arm factor and event noise; zero mean.
predeclared_scenarios.sparse_empty_days: Shared sparse active-date mask (35% daily activity), cell activity conditional on active dates (55%), and zero-mean outcomes; empty calendar days preserved.

scope: Synthetic-only null calibration; not actual validation or future-data readiness.
